  have hY n : Integrable (T n) (ν (V d) B) := cost_int V d B _ (fuel_pos ..) _ _
  have ht : u≤150 := by

proof_context.conclusion: `u = 1` if `d=l`, else `-(1+w l)+1`, with `u≤150` since `-150≤w l` (`chart_here`); the line budget `hT` comes from `line_cost`.
